claim_dispositions.R213-1: Listed curved3D matrices are nonscalar; explicit positive-definite opposite-sign overlap scalar counterexample retained. Two-dimensional overlap pencil is scalar; no universal nonscalarity.
claim_dispositions.R213-2: Locus det B includes8/9 and3/4 prefactors; det M uses their squares.
claim_dispositions.R214-1: General D07 congruence and Schur shift retained. Simple branch rescaling restricted to D07-only star line; mixed PD counterexample retained.
claim_dispositions.R214-2: Generic irreducibility separated from specializations. Four W1 slices exclude two quadrics; other factors and off-plane loci remain open. W1 basis1 and tested locus-plane results retained.
claim_dispositions.R214-3: Radical loci use raw coefficient ideals, containment and power membership with coefficient-field relation, replacing invalid factor-collection.
claim_dispositions.R214-4: Shear and volume registration proved on two separately named formal slices; no all-independent-parameter theorem.
claim_dispositions.R214-5: Separate pairwise bounds are only necessary for PD; explicit non-PD box point retained.
claim_dispositions.R214-6: Block determinant sign (-1)^n stated; n4 specialization positive.
claim_dispositions.RUNTIME-1: Fixed bounded extracted helper, current105 and declared source/citation closure replace moving historical imports; all34original occurrences and4helpers preserved.
claim_dispositions.physical_scope: Finite supplied-cell algebra only; no kernel/action selector, physical assembly or metric, propagator, gravity, dynamics, continuum or completedTOE established. Historical asserted PASS/status never grants audit authority.
